ideas.carta-do-front: Create a fictional wartime short about a 1940s soldier writing a letter inside a canvas tent. He pauses to watch the lantern flame, then keeps writing as shadows move around him. Use intimate narration and a restrained, emotional tone.
ideas.raposa-lanterna: The selected character follows a little fox carrying a glowing lantern through a misty forest. Fireflies light the path as they explore together. Make it a gentle, curious bedtime adventure.
ideas.anuncio-burger-camera-lenta: A slow-motion product ad for my burger: a hand lowers the top bun, the cheese settles and steam rises. Use a close view with shallow depth of field, match the ingredients in my photo and keep the focus on the food.
ideas.anuncio-creme-selfie: A natural selfie-style ad for my face cream. The presenter lifts the jar toward the lens, tilts it, touches a cheek and smiles in soft morning light. Focus on the package and texture I provide, without invented skin results or testimonials.
